duration: At least 40 hours through the summer
notes: The page says nothing about housing or rides.
name: Teen Volunteer Program at The Wilds
what_you_do: Teens choose one or both of two paths. Restoration Ecology has more field work. Conservation Education means talking with visitors. It is at a wildlife conservation center.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 through 17 who like animals and nature and enjoy talking with visitors. The page asks for at least 40 hours of volunteer service over the summer.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted on the volunteer page. The visitor season runs May through October for adult volunteers.
how_to_apply: Click the Apply Now button under Teen Volunteers on the volunteer page. It is an online form.
